A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us in shaping the future of offshore wind. As our Traverse Equipment Owner, you will serve as the technical authority and lifecycle owner for traverse equipment used in offshore installation and servicing operations. You will be responsible for ensuring equipment performance, reliability, safety, and long-term value across a global fleet.

Working at the intersection of engineering, operations, project execution, suppliers, and management, you will play a key role in aligning diverse stakeholder needs and translating them into clear requirements, priorities, and improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management capabilities, sound technical judgement, and the ability to balance operational, commercial, and safety considerations.

You will drive the development of the traverse equipment roadmap, monitor fleet performance, and lead continuous improvement efforts throughout the equipment lifecycle. By fostering collaboration, standardization, and the adoption of new technologies, you will help ensure that our traverse solutions continue to support safe and efficient offshore operations worldwide.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Own the traverse equipment lifecycle, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, safety, and long-term business value.

• Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, success criteria, and approved improvement initiatives.

• Develop and maintain the traverse equipment roadmap and prioritized backlog, including technology development and investment needs.

• Monitor fleet performance, assess incidents and lessons learned, and drive corrective actions, upgrades, and risk mitigation measures.

• Promote knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and the adoption of innovative technologies across the Equipment organization.

What You Bring

• An Engineering degree (Mechanical, Marine, Civil, Industrial, or similar) and at least 10 years of technical experience in equipment development, maintenance, or asset management within offshore wind or a comparable heavy-industry environment.

• Proven experience with traverse systems, lifting equipment, stabilization systems, motion control technologies, or other equipment used for offshore heavy-load handling.

• Demonstrated experience in equipment ownership, technical leadership, or lifecycle management of complex engineered products.

• Ability to convert operational challenges and user feedback into technical requirements, validation criteria, and improvement plans.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach.

About the Team

You will join a global team responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of specialized offshore equipment. The team combines operational experience with engineering expertise to ensure equipment reliability, safety, and efficiency throughout its lifecycle. Together, we drive innovation, standardization, and best practices that support offshore wind projects worldwide.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Paid holidays and parental leave

• Employer-funded pension

• Subsidised lunch and more

jobs.occupation: International Customer Success Manager for a Copenhagen grid-tech start-up
jobs.description:
Are you a customer-facing project manager who thrives on paving the way to success for B2B customers? Do you speak fluent German and English – and perhaps Spanish/Italian? Do you see yourself in a fast-growing start-up with an international team that is securing critical electrical infrastructure?

Then you could be Oktogrid’s new Customer Success Manager!

About Oktogrid

Oktogrid helps secure critical infrastructure by bringing power transformers online for higher reliability and a more sustainable operation. Oktogrid’s sensor solution significantly accelerates the path to getting access to the right data to support operators with the necessary insights for their decision-making.

Founded in 2020. Oktogrid has the continued backing of major European investors, including ABB Electrification and Elewit Ventures, and works with a wide range of grid operators across Europe. The company has 14 employees, most of whom are based at the Copenhagen office, with sales colleagues based in Germany and the Netherlands. Oktogrid also works with an international development team. English is the company language.

About the role

Reporting directly to the CEO, who also heads up sales, you will ensure that Oktogrid’s customers get off to a strong start and support them on their journey as they continue to benefit of the value from the solution. As the Customer Success Manager, you will follow each new customer closely throughout the first 3-9 months – from installation workshops to confidently onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform.

You will remain their trusted point of contact for the entire customer journey, while your experience in project coordination will ensure that the right expertise from your colleagues is involved whenever needed. Your job is not to acquire new customers, but to build strong relationships with existing ones, identify new needs and plant the seeds for further collaboration. You will be based at the Copenhagen office, with occasional travel.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Running a structured onboarding process for new customers – from project kick-off workshops to onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform

• 
Following up closely with customers and holding regular check-ins to ensure that they get the value they expect

• 
Owning a portfolio of Danish and international customers, with a focus on German-speaking markets

• 
Engaging with a rich map of stakeholders within each customer organisation – for example, the operations managers in each region – so that the solution becomes part of their day-to-day work

• 
Bringing in Oktogrid’s technical experts when customers need in-depth answers about transformers, deeper data analytics or software integrations

• 
Identifying new needs and opportunities – such as additional analytics modules and reports – and passing them on to the product and operations teams

• 
Capturing customer feedback and success stories for Product and Marketing

• 
Building and continuously improving Oktogrid’s Customer Success process and playbook

About you

A background in utilities or within energy is a plus, but not a requirement – Oktogrid’s experts are at hand when in-depth expertise is needed. What matters most is that you are excellent at building trust, maintaining close dialogue with customers and picking up on when to involve your extended team at Oktogrid. Having previously worked within energy, telecoms, IT, SaaS or other B2B industries in which you have delivered complex solutions to large customers are relevant fields of experience. We envisage that you have:

• 
5-10 years’ experience in Customer Success or related customer-facing roles with B2B customers

• 
Experience of working with structured customer processes – ideally gained in a medium-sized company where you have had broad responsibility

• 
Experience in delivering complex solutions and managing long-term customer relationships, rather than having ambitions of driving transactional sales

• 
Technical understanding and the ability to explain complex solutions clearly to expert as well as non-expert stakeholders

• 
A proactive approach – you bring your own ideas to the table and take ownership of improving the way things are done

• 
Genuine curiosity about customers’ needs – you spot opportunities that create further value for them

• 
The drive to succeed in a fast-growing start-up as part of a high-performing, international team – and a preference for working from the office in close contact with customers and colleagues

• 
Fluent in German and English, written and spoken. Spanish and Italian would be a strong advantage, as many customers prefer to communicate in their own language

• 
Experience with utilities and an understanding of asset management practices would be an advantage, but is not a requirement

• 
A valid permit to live and work in Denmark (EU/EEA citizenship or a Danish work permit)

Oktogrid offers

• 
A key role with real influence in a company actively driving a meaningful climate impact

• 
Office-based work with flexible working hours, the option of working from home one day a week and a partly paid company lunch scheme every day

• 
A modern office space in Copenhagen at the border between Vesterbro and Frederiksberg, located close to green areas and a vibrant hub where innovation meets great city culture

• 
A salary based on qualifications, and a company-wide bonus scheme

Interested?

Apply as soon as possible by clicking the application button and uploading your CV and, if you wish, a cover letter, both in English.

If you have any questions, please contact Martin Nielsen, Headhunter & Partner at Landau Headhunting, on +45 8122 8180. Landau Headhunting is managing the recruitment process on behalf of Oktogrid, so please direct all enquiries to us. We will review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you! Read more about Oktogrid at https://oktogrid.io

_Do you want to be the commercial anchor between our customers and our product offerings in our Heat/Cooling Division? Do you enjoy connecting customer needs with commercial opportunities and technical possibilities? Do you want to help shape smart metering products and solutions that accelerate the green transition?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Senior Commercial Product Manager for Hardware Solutions, you will work cross functionally on product lifecycle optimization of our Heating and Cooling solutions to align product development with market demands, customer needs, and revenue goals. To do so, you will be responsible for driving the commercial aspects of our product portfolio, including product launches and lifecycle management.

More specifically, you will be:

• Managing the product lifecycle from idea to end-of-life

• Driving product discovery and portfolio optimization projects in close collaboration with our customers, Sales and Marketing

• Owning the business case and commercial roadmap for hardware products, including pricing, to ensure profitability and market fit

• Working with colleagues across the organization, training Sales and Customer Support to succeed

• Challenging status quo to ensure continuity of commercially viable solutions

You will be at the forefront of decision-making, steering the direction of our products and solutions. In this role, you will have the mandate to act, and the responsibility needed to make impactful decisions that help our customers adapt to a more sustainable future.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Commercial Product Management, you will become part of a team of highly skilled colleagues who work every day to bring smart metering solutions and services to our markets. The Commercial Product Management team combines strong commercial capabilities with a solid technical understanding of our solutions to drive profitability and help our customers succeed in energy efficiency and the green transition.

The team is part of the Product Management organization for Heat/Cooling products and solutions and brings together colleagues with strong technical, commercial and strategic expertise. This diversity helps us achieve a high level of quality and challenge status quo, which is something we value highly in our department.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for an ambitious and passionate colleague who brings a profound drive to deliver winning and value-adding solutions to the green transition. You have a natural drive and an “outside in” perspective in everything you do. Ideally, you bring experience of working in a matrix, from an international setting.

To succeed in this role, we envision that you:

• Have experience working at the intersection of customers, business, technology and products, driving decisions across functions and organizational levels

• Have a great commercial understanding combined with a high technical interest – or vice versa

• Can apply Product Management disciplines to translate customer and market insights into successful products

• Are an effective communicator who excels in building and maintaining strong relationships both internally and with customers

• Can translate technical information to a broad audience

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Commercial Product Management, Emil Warncke on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Global Service Specialist – DO/EIMCO, Flotation, PCV, DSG

****Position Summary

**FLS is seeking a highly skilled and professional Global Service Specialist to support the erection, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and operational startup of commercial and industrial separation equipment. This role focuses primarily on mechanical work and Installation & Commissioning (I&C) activities for thickeners and flotation cells, with additional responsibility for equipment such as clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, and agitated tanks.

The Global Service Specialist serves as FLS’s primary onsite representative and is responsible for delivering high‑quality technical service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution. This position requires extensive international travel and the ability to work independently under demanding conditions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute onsite erection, installation, alignment, and commissioning of mechanical systems and I&C activities for thickeners, flotation cells, and related separation equipment.

• Lead pre‑commissioning and commissioning processes to ensure equipment meets design, safety, and performance requirements.

• Support operational startup, troubleshooting, and optimization of equipment performance.

• Conduct inspections, testing, calibration, and verification of mechanical and control‑related systems.

• Coordinate onsite project activities, schedules, and resources to ensure timely completion.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project management teams to resolve technical issues.

• Prepare accurate and professional documentation, including installation records, commissioning reports, and service summaries.

• Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

• Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, providing training, guidance, and technical support.

• Represent FLS with professionalism and integrity in all customer interactions.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Strong mechanical background with hands‑on experience in Installation & Commissioning (I&C) of industrial process equipment.

• Experience with thickeners, flotation cells, clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, or similar industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions under pressure.

• Strong project management skills, including planning, coordination, and documentation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high‑quality technical reports.

• Ability and willingness to travel internationally up to 70% of the time.

• Professional demeanor with the ability to represent the company effectively onsite.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in commissioning or startup of industrial process systems.

• Background in mining, minerals processing, water treatment, or heavy industrial environments.

• Multilingual capabilities or experience working in multicultural settings.

• Ability to meet all medical and physical fitness requirements necessary to obtain work authorization for high‑altitude job sites.

**Competencies

**

• Technical proficiency in mechanical systems and industrial equipment

• Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities

• Customer service orientation

• Professional communication and reporting skills

• Ability to perform effectively in high‑pressure environments

• Self‑motivation and independence in field operations

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

_Are you motivated by becoming the technical expert behind products and solutions that support clean water and energy? Do you thrive in a role where you connect technical development, business needs, and customer requirements? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence products throughout their entire lifecycle while collaborating with stakeholders across the organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**In the role as our next Technical Product Specialist within our software applications, your job will be to provide technical expertise across the product lifecycle while ensuring that products, solutions, and technical documentation remain accurate, compliant, and competitive.

More specifically you will be:

• Acting as the technical liaison between Research and Development, Sales, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders

• Providing technical support including tender support, sales support, product training, and advanced troubleshooting

• Serving as the technical expert on products, configurations, software solutions, and applications

• Maintaining technical product information and documentation

• Supporting product lifecycle activities including new product development, maintenance, and phase in and phase out activities

You will experience the freedom to act and leave your mark on how we manage and support our products throughout their lifecycle. Therefore, you will work closely with technical and commercial stakeholders across the organization, gain deep insight into our products and technologies, and play a key role in ensuring knowledge sharing, product adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, you will become part of the technical product management team. As a team, we are committed to ensuring our products remain technically accurate, competitive, and capable of meeting both market and business requirements, and you will have a key role in achieving this. In the team you will experience close collaboration with colleagues across product management, development, customer service, sales, and supply chain. Together we support products throughout their lifecycle while ensuring strong stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Did you know? As a Technical Product Specialist, you will work with stakeholders from many different functions, making every day an opportunity to learn something new about our products, technologies, and customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Technical Product Specialist who is ready to take ownership of technical product activities and who is motivated by solving complex challenges. You achieve this through strong collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a structured approach to your work.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Engineering within Electronics, Software, Mechatronics, or a similar field.

• Have an understanding of product development, product lifecycle management, and technical product support

• Have experience with, or an understanding of, software-related systems such as Swagger documentation, Jira, Confluence or comparable platforms. A general end-to-end understanding of hardware and connectivity along with insights to APIsis an advantage.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to communicate technical information clearly

• Have experience with product related systems such as Configure Price Quote, Product Lifecycle Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, or similar platforms.

We also value experience developing and delivering technical training and knowledge sharing activities

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than the ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, cycle team, during our yearly summer festival or on the padel court. For example, is our Head of System Engineering and Information Technology Denmark also our volunteer padel instructor while our Software Test Engineer runs weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Technical Product Management, Kirsten Sahl, by phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**Get to know us

**At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible all with the purpose of securing clean water and energy to the maximum number of people. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us. Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr81,720.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

**Job Description

**Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments, working with some of the most complex and modern data solutions on the market? Are you ready to take ownership of shaping data architecture? If so, you might be our next colleague.

In Data Management, you join a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

As a Senior Data Architect, you will work in the intersection of technology and business. Data is at the core of everything we do, and our analyses, advice, and solutions consistently create real value for our customers. Your work involve developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, distribute, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Spark, Kafka, Dagster, Airflow, Terraform and others.

**Responsibilites

**

• Designing, modeling, and building data solutions such as data platforms, data warehouse architecture, and business intelligence applications.

• Taking co-ownership of data architecture, defining technical direction, and driving customer advisory, data strategy, and business analysis in collaboration with the project team and customer.

• Leading and mentoring team members, prioritizing and organizing work, and providing technical guidance and direction.

• Quickly getting up to speed on existing solutions and taking ownership of them, while defining the right path forward for new projects based on best practices.

• Performing technical quality assurance and reviews on data models, ETL processes, and solution architecture across projects.

**About You

**You hold a relevant degree in data science, software engineering, computer science, mathematical modelling, or a similar field, along with solid professional experience in data management. Through your professional experience, you have gained deep technical expertise and a structured, logical approach to solving complex data challenges. As a Senior Data Architect, you are comfortable stepping into a leadership role guiding both people and the technical direction, and you thrive in a collaborative, development-oriented environment with a focus on continuous learning.

To succeed in this role, you have significant experience with:

• Designing and implementing data solutions, including data modelling, ETL/ELT, and data warehousing.

• Multiple languages and technologies such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R, as well as Fabric, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, Databricks, Dagster, Terraform and others.

• Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Supporting customers and colleagues through professional expertise and guidance.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

**Continue developing with us

**At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Role

**In this role, you will own and develop our Reward and benefits processes across the company. The scope includes our annual pay review, market benchmarking, benefits and incentive schemes, job architecture, and Rewards activities.

This role would suit a proactive Rewards professional who has previously perhaps worked in a team and is looking for their first stand alone. The expectations on you are to further develop and optimise our recently implemented rewards solutions, in particular in Workday, and support all of the company's rewards processes.

Our company is evolving fast and so an enjoyment of a dynamic and demanding environment with a delivery focus is essential for success.

**What You Will Do

**

• Developing Rewards in Workday to operate efficiently.

• Carrying out benchmarking and updating of pay against the job architecture

• Lead the annual pay-review process across the business.

• Maintaining up to date job architecture with regular reviews to ensure embedded in the organisation

• Develop and maintain our benefit and incentive programmes.

• Compiling required reports and data for pay budgeting, reviewing and equal pay requirements globally

• Continues to ensure that pay and benefits attract the highest calibre of talent available in our markets

**Essential

****What you bring

**

• Three to four years of hands-on experience in reward, compensation, benefits, or a closely related field that includes pay reviews, market benchmarking, benefits, incentive schemes, and job architecture.

• Experience managing reward or benefit activities across different countries, including cross-border pay equity and benefit plans.

• Hands-on experience using Mercer / Mercer Win benchmarking data and tools to compare jobs and pay across different markets.

• Workday experience is a must, particularly configuring job profiles, job architecture and running pay reviews.

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer to keep the fun going for years to come.

As a Game Engineer on Subway Surfers, you’ll work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to take ideas from concept through implementation and into the hands of the above-mentioned hundreds of millions of players. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve both the game and the way we build it.

Working with LiveOps lets you get instant feedback on your work - working with one of the largest LiveOps games makes it unique. Read below and get in touch!

**Responsibilities

**

• Develop and maintain gameplay features, systems, and content for Subway Surfers using Unity and C#

• Collaborate with Designers, Artists, and other Engineers to take features from concept through implementation and release

• Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase

• Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality

• Debug and resolve technical issues across gameplay systems and live features

• Contribute to improving the tools, workflows, and development practices used by the team

Life at SYBO

You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner, Engineers, Designers, and Artists on the game team, familiarize yourself with the codebase and development pipeline, and start contributing to your first features.

• In your first three months, you’ll be contributing independently to features and content and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers codebase.

• In your first twelve months, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to the development of features and content from planning through release and helping shape technical solutions for the game - and you’ve received plenty of player feedback on things you’ve worked on!

**Requirements

**

• Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#

• Professional experience developing games, ideally on mobile

• Solid hands-on experience with Unity

• Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns

• Experience collaborating with multiple disciplines to develop and deliver game features

• Experience working with version control systems such as Git

• Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

• Experience working on a live game and regularly shipping new features and content

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

Do you have experience configuring, testing and commissioning control systems for high-voltage substations? Would you like to apply your expertise to projects supporting Denmark’s electricity transmission grid? Join COWI as a Substation Control and Automation Specialist.

Develop and commission substation control systems

We are looking for an experienced specialist to work on control and automation systems for Energinet’s 132–400 kV substations. Projects range from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites.

You will design, configure, test and commission substation control systems, including remote terminal units (RTUs), bay control units (BCUs) and human–machine interfaces (HMIs). Working closely with other specialists, you will ensure that these systems operate correctly and integrate with the substation’s primary equipment, protection systems and communication infrastructure.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design and configure substation control and monitoring functions in accordance with functional requirements and customer specifications.

• Configure, test and commission RTUs, bay control units and HMIs.

• Configure and verify communication interfaces between control devices, protection equipment and remote control systems.

• Plan and perform functional and integration testing to verify control functions, signal exchange and correct operation of system interfaces.

• Troubleshoot configuration, communication and interface issues in collaboration with other technical specialists.

• Prepare and maintain configuration documentation, test procedures and test records.

• Coordinate technical interfaces with colleagues responsible for protection, communication systems, electrical design and primary equipment

• Undertake the designated on-site role of “holdleder” when required and subject to the relevant qualifications and authorisation.

Your expertise

You take a systematic approach to configuration, testing and troubleshooting. You work independently, pay close attention to technical detail and collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers. You understand how individual devices and interfaces contribute to the operation of the complete substation control system.

You will also bring:

• A relevant qualification in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical background, combined with at least five years of relevant experience with control systems for high-voltage substations.

• Demonstrated experience configuring and testing substation control equipment from multiple manufacturers.

• Practical experience with IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 61850 communication protocols and standards.

• A sound understanding of the interfaces between substation control systems, protection equipment and high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience with functional testing, system integration and commissioning of substation control systems.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to obtain the required security clearance and meet the qualification and authorisation requirements for acting as “holdleder” at high-voltage substations.

Your place of work

Depending on project requirements, you may work from one of COWI’s offices in Denmark, at Energinet project locations or partly from home. Testing and commissioning activities will require attendance at the relevant project sites. Travel within Denmark is expected.

A place to work and so much more

At COW, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Head of Discipline Carsten Sass Husum at CSHU@COWI.COM.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Student Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will support a wide range of operational and financial activities that are essential to our day-to-day business. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Procurement, and external vendors, gaining valuable insight into financial processes and stakeholder management within an international organization.

This is an excellent opportunity for a student who enjoys working with data, optimizing processes, and collaborating with multiple stakeholders while developing practical experience alongside their studies.

As a Student Assistant, you will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you will gain hands-on experience with financial operations, procurement processes, vendor management, and business analytics. You will have the opportunity to build practical skills, work with experienced professionals, and contribute meaningfully to the team's success while continuing your studies at our HQ office in Valby.

**Key Responsibilities

**As our Student Assistant, your responsibilities will include:

• Review and approval of vendor invoices in accordance with internal procedures

• Communicate with external vendors and the Accounts Payable team regarding invoicing and payment-related matters

• Coordinate with the Procurement team on Purchase Requisition and Purchase Order activities

• Assist in monitoring departmental spend and help maintain department financial overviews and accruals

• Maintain and update financial data to support dashboards, reporting, and data visualization

• Support access management processes, including maintaining access records and tracking user permissions

• Prepare, write, and distribute meeting minutes and follow up on agreed action items

• Assist with a variety of ad hoc administrative, operational, and analytical tasks as needed

**Requirments

**You Are Currently In The Final Year Of Your Bachelor's Degree And Intend To Continue Your Studies At The Master's Level. Relevant Fields Of Study Include

• Business Administration

• Economics

• Business Economics

• Finance

• Accounting

• Or a similar business-related discipline

**Moreover, You Are Someone Who Is

**

• Proactive and eager to take initiative

• Curious by nature and motivated to learn new systems and processes

• Outgoing and comfortable communicating with colleagues across different functions

• Structured, organized, and attentive to detail

• Able to work independently while also enjoying being part of a collaborative team

• Comfortable working with numbers and data and interested in financial and operational processes

• Experience with or strong interest in AI, automation, etc. will be considered an advantage

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools is an advantage but not a requirement

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK180,00---180,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

What we do at OrderYOYO:

We help restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

About the Role

Commercial Data Analyst

Location: Denmark, Copenhagen Office

Hours: 40hours/ week

Salary: 40,000DKK/ month plus bonus

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Commercial Data Analyst to join us, reporting to our CCO. You’ll turn data from across our commercial teams, covering sales, account management, customer success, B2B marketing, pricing and partner performance, into clear, actionable insight, giving our leaders one trusted view of performance across every OrderYOYO market. Working closely with market leads, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Product, you’ll help us understand what drives growth in each market and focus our efforts where they’ll make the biggest difference!

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

• Analysing performance across all our commercial activities, including sales, account management, customer success, marketing and partnerships, in every market.

• Tracking and reporting on key commercial metrics such as new restaurant acquisition, revenue, order volumes, churn, retention and pipeline conversion.

• Owning our regular commercial reporting, including weekly, monthly and quarterly performance packs for leadership.

• Designing, building and maintaining dashboards that give a single, trusted view of performance and let teams self-serve their data.

• Comparing performance between our 11 markets, teams and channels to spot what’s working, where we can improve and where the risks are.

• Analysing the impact of pricing, campaigns and commercial initiatives on performance.

• Delivering ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support commercial decisions, business cases and initiatives.

• Making sure commercial data is accurate and consistent across markets, working with CRM and system owners to close any gaps.

• Defining and documenting KPIs so everyone measures performance in the same way.

• Supporting forecasting, target setting and planning with Finance, and flagging variances against target early.

• Your success will be measured on the accuracy and timeliness of reporting, dashboard adoption, data quality, turnaround on ad hoc requests, forecast accuracy and stakeholder satisfaction.

What We Are Looking For In You:

• Proven experience in a commercial, sales, revenue or business analyst role.

• Experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, and experience working with CRM data (e.g. HubSpot or Salesforce).

• A strong understanding of commercial metrics such as revenue, pipeline, conversion, churn and retention, ideally within B2B SaaS.

• Analytical and curious: you can turn data into clear, actionable insight and recommendations.

• A confident communicator who can present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.

• Highly organised, with great attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Experience working across multiple markets, or with Python or R, is an advantage.

Great to Have

• Experience working across multiple markets or countries.

• Experience with Python or R.

• Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced business.

• Experience supporting forecasting, target setting or commercial planning alongside Finance.

• Experience defining KPIs or improving data governance and processes.

About the Company Culture

Who we are at OrderYOYO: Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One Team) are what make us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Benefits

• Monthly Friday Socials and regular ad-hoc socials.

• Quarterly Conferences and training days.

• Employee Awards.

• Holiday buying Scheme.

• Personal development plans and Genuine career development opportunities.

Job Description Summary

The Production Engineer – Calibration & Maintenance is responsible for the calibration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production, inspection, measurement, and test equipment used in a regulated medical device manufacturing environment.

The role works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, equipment owners, and external service providers to ensure equipment remains calibrated, maintained, compliant, and available for production.

Responsibilities include day-to-day calibration and preventive maintenance coordination, HxGN EAM administration, calibration assessments, controlled procedures and work instructions, supplier coordination, and equipment compliance.

This is a hands-on Production Engineering role supporting manufacturing operations across scanner/system assembly, mechanical and electrical/electronic assembly, software configuration/loading, packaging and labeling, and testing/final acceptance.

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

• Coordinate the site calibration program, including calibration schedules, call-in activities, equipment status, due dates, and timely completion.

• Coordinate internal and external calibration activities, including equipment preparation, shipment, return, documentation review, and release back to production.

• Ensure new, returned, overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment is appropriately assessed and controlled before use.

• Act as SME for calibration and maintenance activities in HxGN EAM, maintaining asset records, calibration setups, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, task plans, and supporting documentation.

• Perform and support calibration assessments, including equipment requirements, criticality, acceptance criteria, calibration methods, frequencies, and maintenance needs.

• Develop and maintain calibration and maintenance procedures, SOPs, and work instructions in collaboration with equipment owners, SMEs, and Quality.

• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for production and test equipment while minimizing disruption to manufacturing.

• Support investigations, risk assessments, and product-impact assessments related to overdue, failed, or out-of-tolerance equipment, and provide input to NC/INV/CAPA activities where applicable.

• Coordinate external calibration and maintenance suppliers, including quotations, service activities, documentation, and AGORA purchase orders.

• Support internal and external audits by ensuring calibration and maintenance records are complete, traceable, compliant, and audit-ready.

• Monitor calibration and maintenance performance and drive improvements in equipment compliance, availability, data quality, and execution efficiency.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Metrology, Maintenance, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Experience with calibration, preventive maintenance, equipment management, or Production Engineering in a regulated manufacturing environment.

• Understanding of calibration principles, equipment control, documentation, traceability, and manufacturing process requirements.

• Experience with computerized maintenance or Enterprise Asset Management systems, preferably HxGN EAM or comparable systems.

• Experience working within controlled procedures, work instructions, and change management processes.

• Experience coordinating suppliers, service activities, quotations, and purchase orders.

• Knowledge of GMP and Quality Management System requirements within regulated manufacturing.

Desired Characteristics

• Experience within medical device manufacturing or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Hands-on and practical approach to supporting manufacturing equipment and production operations.

• Structured working style with strong ownership and ability to manage recurring deadlines.

• Strong collaboration skills across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external suppliers.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

• Comfortable balancing equipment compliance, production continuity, quality requirements, and operational priorities.

• Proactive and improvement-focused approach to equipment reliability and calibration/maintenance processes

Join Pharmacosmos in a newly established function, in a role combining people leadership with direct involvement in clinical processes, compliance and continuous improvement.

Build and lead a new Clinical Administration & Compliance function

As Director, Clinical Administration & Compliance, you will report directly to the Senior Director, Head of Clinical Operations, Trine Kolding, and take on a key role combining leadership with hands-on responsibility for clinical trial administration, processes and operational GCP compliance.

You will lead and develop the Clinical Administration and Process Management functions, setting clear priorities and direction while fostering collaboration, accountability and high-quality delivery.
